D689 / IR-1, accepted by Travis 2026-11-17T11:24Z (#2312): explicitly retire plans_use_platform_app_tip's unsupported OpenAI desktop-app promotion expectation. Main disabled startup tips at 4e463cd1f2fd3ccbbb7a4e7f3139fb956cb4ab83; sync #2217 retained that policy. Replacement plans_never_show_startup_tooltips_or_promotions requires get_tooltip and preferred_tooltip to return None for all 20 PlanType variants plus no plan, with all 32 preferred-tip seeds, without platform gating or a headless-Linux-dependent expectation. Applies on macOS, Windows and Linux; lower-level random selection, desktop launcher/session selection, rendering snapshots and announcement selector tests remain unchanged. No production change, skipped test or full-TUI qualification claim; remaining CLI-dependent #2312 failures stay open under #2274.

#2446: disable transport pooling in the shared builder so Connection: close cannot be defeated by a keep-alive response. Upstream 64335d1afd added the unchanged regression with hyper 1.11.1; sync retains main's hyper 1.8.1, hyper-util 0.1.20 and reqwest 0.12.28. Main lacks that regression. Builder route caching remains; TCP/TLS connections are no longer pooled. Linux comparison and final validation are recorded on #2446; no test weakened.
